prompt: Write a one-star review of the Grand Canyon from a visitor who feels it was too big.
response:
★☆☆☆☆

Honestly, the Grand Canyon was way too big. I thought I’d be able to take a quick look, maybe snap a photo, and move on with my day, but no—this thing just kept going. Everywhere I looked, there was more canyon. Too much canyon.

The views were overwhelming, the walking distances were unreasonable, and nobody warned me that “grand” apparently means “excessively large.” It felt like nature was trying too hard. A smaller, more manageable canyon would have been much better.

Also, there was no easy way to see the whole thing at once, which seems like poor planning. Would not recommend unless you specifically enjoy enormous holes in the ground.
